msg: Hello, I'm French, I'm staying at a hotel on Isla Grande for 4 nights. I'm an Open Water diver (last dive in March). Can I dive two days in a row from here? How much?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, you can dive on two consecutive days from Isla Grande. Since your last dive was in March, the refresher requirement would only apply if it has been more than two years since your last dive.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

Both plans include equipment, insurance and a PADI professional; lunch isn’t included. Hotel pick-up is available if your hotel has boat access.

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you prefer daytime dives only, or a plan with a night dive?

msg: I'm staying at San Pedro de Majagua. I'd like 2 dives on Wednesday and 2 dives on Thursday. Is there a package for two days? How do I book?
reply:
Yes, there’s a two-day package with 4 daytime dives, but it’s for divers already on the islands. For two dives on each day, you can book the 2-dive Fun Dives option for each day.

You can choose your dates and number of people through the booking system. It closes at 4:30 PM the day before; for the next day, book before then. There is always availability, except on December 25 and January 1, and trips may be suspended due to adverse weather.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊

msg: Just me, 1 person. How do I book the 2-day package from the islands?
reply:
For two days with 2 daytime dives each day, the *4-dive package (4 daytime dives)* is the matching option for guests already on the islands. Pick-up at San Pedro de Majagua is confirmed and included.

I don’t have the booking link for that specific package handy. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to help arrange it?

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day, already on the islands)*
💰 *124 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, full diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en
